subject.title: Discord compaction still fails with provider_error_4xx after #90496 closure on 2026.6.5

question: When a Discord Codex session hits budget compaction and Codex returns provider_error_4xx, should OpenClaw rotate/preserve the channel into a fresh session, surface a provider-auth recovery path, or keep manual recovery only?
rationale: The source shows the failure path and related partial fixes, but choosing automatic rotation versus explicit user/operator recovery changes session-state behavior and possible transcript preservation semantics.

options.title: Define Provider-4xx Recovery Policy
options.body: Choose and implement one explicit provider-4xx recovery behavior with live Discord/Codex proof and regression coverage.

options.title: Wait For Timeout PR Only
options.body: Treat the timeout-progress PR as sufficient only if maintainers accept that provider-403 recovery is outside this issue.

options.title: Keep Manual Recovery
options.body: Document that provider-4xx compaction failures require manual `/new`, `/compact`, or auth/provider repair rather than automatic rotation.

recommendation.title: Define Provider-4xx Recovery Policy
recommendation.body: Choose and implement one explicit provider-4xx recovery behavior with live Discord/Codex proof and regression coverage.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged partial fix and explicitly identified this provider-4xx/rotation policy as out of scope, making him the best routed owner for the follow-up choice.
